condition_resolutions.evidence: The 51-file allowlist excludes the three image paths and legacy manifest; negative checks reject paths, hashes, URLs, and executable tokens.
The staged page states that Three-Globe example images are excluded and describes the retained NASA surface as historical/decorative with no endorsement implied.
GCB, WPP, Ember, CCKP CMIP6, and CCKP ERA5 licence bases, source roles, changes, and limitations remain in public and machine-readable evidence.
Public page, interactive UI, fallback, and this artifact state source-data evidence classes and deny human review and legal certification.
No target, finance, score, grade, offset, mismatched-scope, or performance output is enabled; order remains same-metric magnitude only.
The public transform removes the query token, fixes higher values to higher relief, and the verifier rejects regressions.
The existing eight-role production release package and globe-asset signature trust remain absent/unprovisioned and fail closed; the AI lane is separately routed.
The exact 51-file stage, four deterministic transforms, 249-entity rollback snapshot, cache epoch, and strict aggregate dispatch are independently verified.
Two Luna, one Terra, and one Sol report are complete, exactly pinned, and bound to the same canonical subject digest and review-request SHA.

known_limitations: This is four AI reviews across three model families, not four institutions and not human scientific review.
Country-level uncertainty is unavailable for several inputs; CMIP6 spread is shown, while ERA5 OLS trend uncertainty is not propagated.
Some upstream raw sources are referenced by exact external receipts rather than archived in this repository.
A standalone legacy source-routing snapshot checker has pre-existing source-registry hash drift; CCI-specific checks and the canonical request pin the current registry bytes.
Cloudflare production status is an operational post-merge requirement and is not implied by this review artifact.
